description: Representative WOFOST soil configuration for the VHR-YieldNet test field near 28.0499639 N, 75.1287765 E, Jhunjhunu region, Rajasthan. Texture is represented as sandy clay loam based on the extracted SoilGrids 250 m pixel composition. Values are not field-laboratory measurements.

parameter_status.SMW: representative texture-based value; not field measured
parameter_status.SMFCF: representative texture-based value; not field measured
parameter_status.SM0: representative texture-based value; not field measured
parameter_status.CRAIRC: representative WOFOST/PCSE soil value; not field measured
parameter_status.K0: representative WOFOST soil value; not field measured
parameter_status.SOPE: representative WOFOST soil value; not field measured
parameter_status.KSUB: representative WOFOST soil value; not field measured
parameter_status.RDMSOL: provisional development assumption for wheat; not field measured

notes: SoilGrids composition was extracted from the 250 m pixel containing the test field.
The field polygon is much smaller than the 250 m SoilGrids pixel.
SMW, SMFCF and SM0 are representative texture-based values for sandy clay loam.
CRAIRC, K0, SOPE and KSUB are representative WOFOST/PCSE soil parameters and are not field measurements.
RDMSOL of 150 cm is a provisional development assumption for the wheat simulation and must not be described as measured soil depth.
These parameters should be replaced or recalibrated if field soil measurements become available.
